name: Evident AI
tagline: Agents turn body-camera video into a review-ready evidence report in minutes, with tamper-evident proofs.
problem: Officers spend hours transcribing body-camera footage; vendors are slow and expensive.
solution: Specialised agents transcribe speech with speaker tagging, analyse key frames, assemble a report, and anchor proofs on a blockchain.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload footage and receive a structured report.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Y Combinator: Unicorn Prize” among 261 submissions.
Preserves legal standards while automating the grind.
A solo builder won startup potential.

lessons: A painful, expensive workflow with a clear buyer reads as a startup.
